method: A fresh fullscreen game session was switched through the in-game language menu to Русский VN. The prepared save zc was loaded through the normal menu, then its QuickSave snapshot was loaded with F7 for the gameplay captures. macOS captured each stable screen at native 2560×1600 resolution; the locale label was added afterward without resizing the source frames.

screenshots.review: Confirmed ru-vnrevival title menu with Russian buttons; the locale plaque is complete and unobstructed.
Russian character-creation labels and farm thumbnails render without missing glyphs; the repaired НАЗАД button is visible below them.
Гас's portrait, localized name, and multi-line Russian dialogue render without clipping or missing glyphs.
The tooltip shows Топор, Инструмент, and Используется для рубки дерева. with the localized inventory metadata.
The expanded Знакомства entry, Russian body copy, and 3/28 progress line render within the journal panel.

smapiLog.note: The fresh log records the exact custom locale, all three locale-specific asset loads, the QuickSave F7 load, and no Content Patcher ERROR or WARN entries. SMAPI separately emits its expected Changed save serializer warning for QuickSave 1.5.0.
